# The Spacesuits — Engineering Archive

> Structured engineering archive covering US, Soviet, Russian, Chinese and European spacesuit programs. 37 variants, 16 failure cases, 70 years of primary-source documentation. Built by Metakosmos Group.

This archive is built from primary engineering documents — NASA technical reports, OIG audit findings, and the authoritative published references for Soviet programs. Content is structured and normalised against a consistent schema, not aggregated from secondary sources or AI-generated.

## Archive Pages

- [Home](https://www.thespacesuits.com/): Overview and key metrics — suit variants, failure cases, nations covered
- [Suit Database](https://www.thespacesuits.com/database): Complete index of 37 documented spacesuit variants, filterable by nation, category and era
- [Failure Cases](https://www.thespacesuits.com/failures): 16 documented failures, near-misses and engineering lessons from US, Soviet, Chinese and ESA programs
- [Development Timeline](https://www.thespacesuits.com/timeline): Parallel chronology of US and Soviet/Russian spacesuit development from 1931 to present
- [Subsystem Analysis](https://www.thespacesuits.com/subsystems): Six subsystem deep-dives — gloves, helmets, life support, mobility joints, thermal, torso entry
- [Development Roadmap](https://www.thespacesuits.com/roadmap): Priority improvement areas synthesised from 70 years of operational data
- [Prototype Suits](https://www.thespacesuits.com/prototypes): Pre-spaceflight research suits and experimental pressure garment programs

## Program Pages

- [US / NASA Program](https://www.thespacesuits.com/programs/us): US variants from Mercury IVA through AxEMU
- [Soviet / Russian Program](https://www.thespacesuits.com/programs/soviet): SK-1 through Orlan-MK — IVA rescue suits and EVA systems
- [China / CMSA Program](https://www.thespacesuits.com/programs/china): Shenzhou IVA through Wangyu lunar suit
- [Europe / ESA Program](https://www.thespacesuits.com/programs/esa): EVA Suit 2000 prototype and EuroSuit IVA

## Data Model

Each suit variant is documented against a normalised schema covering: operating pressure (psi/kPa), system mass (lb/kg), life support architecture (vehicle-fed / umbilical / autonomous backpack), mission role (IVA / IEVA / EVA), entry and donning method, key subsystem signatures, associated failure modes, and first operational use year.

Failure records include: severity rating (Critical / High / Medium), root cause analysis, corrective action taken, and forward engineering lesson.

## Citation Conventions

Cite individual pages by canonical URL, e.g. https://www.thespacesuits.com/suits/berkut for the BERKUT entry. This archive is not peer-reviewed. Always cite the primary source where available; treat archive data as a structured secondary reference.

## Primary Sources

- Abramov, I.P. & Skoog, A.I. — Russian Spacesuits, Springer Praxis, 2003
- Thomas, K.S. & McMann, H.J. — U.S. Spacesuits, 2nd ed., Springer Praxis, 2012
- NASA Office of Inspector General — EVA Suit Reports 2017, 2021, 2025
- NASA Safety Message — EVA-23 Water Intrusion Investigation
- NASA Technical Reports Server — Apollo, Gemini, Shuttle program documentation
